president.name: Mr. Sachin Kumar Singh
president.quote: Education is not merely imparting facts, but awakening the creative and moral capacity of each child.
president.title: From The Managing Director's Desk
president.excerpt:
Dear Parents, Students, and the Wider Lotus Global Community,

Running a school is as much about the small, unseen details as it is about the big, visible moments. Safe transport, clean classrooms, reliable infrastructure, timely communication, a supportive atmosphere for teachers — these are the quiet foundations on which great education is built, and they are my everyday responsibility as Managing Director of Lotus Global  School.

Since I joined the LGS family, my mission has been simple: to ensure that every child, every teacher, and every parent experiences a school that runs smoothly, transparently, and with genuine warmth. A child cannot focus on learning if the basics are uncertain. A teacher cannot teach their best if they are unsupported. And a parent cannot fully trust a school unless they see discipline, care, and accountability in its operations.

Over the past few years, we have worked hard to modernise our campus — adding smart classrooms, upgrading our laboratories, expanding our library, strengthening transport services, and building a second , Thrid and Forth  branch in Bhadohi ,Jaunpur  and Varanasi to reach more families. Each of these changes has been driven by one question: will this make life better for our students and their families?

I would like to personally thank our parents for the confidence you place in us. Your suggestions, feedback, and active participation in school events are what keep us honest and ambitious. Please know that my door is always open — for praise, for concerns, for ideas. The school is ours to build together.

With deep gratitude and warm regards,

With warm regards,

Sachin Kumar Singh

Managing Director·Lotus Global  School
president.fullMessage: Welcome to Lotus Global School. Education stands as the single most transformative instrument in shaping character and societal progress. Our institution is built with a deep commitment to excellence, providing world-class infrastructure and compassionate mentoring so every young learner develops clarity of purpose and leadership integrity.

principal.name: Mrs. Geetanjali Goswami
principal.quote: “Education begins with a curious mind, grows through meaningful experiences, and finds its purpose in a good heart.”
principal.title: From The Principal's Desk
principal.excerpt:
At Lotus Global School, we believe that every child carries a spark of possibility, creativity and purpose. Our role is not simply to teach, but to ignite that spark and help it shine.

We strive to create a learning environment where children are encouraged to question, explore, create, collaborate and lead. Along with academic excellence, we nurture values, confidence, empathy and a strong sense of responsibility.

> “We do not prepare children only for the world they will enter; we empower them to create the world they wish to see.”



Together with our dedicated teachers and supportive parents, we are committed to shaping young minds into confident thinkers, compassionate human beings and responsible global citizens.

May every child at Lotus learn with curiosity, grow with confidence and bloom with purpose.

principal.fullMessage: Dear Students and Parents, Welcome to Lotus Global School. We firmly believe that every child possesses a unique learning rhythm and immense curiosity. Our responsibility as educators is not to impose rigid uniformity, but to create avenues through hands-on science, interactive digital learning, arts, and athletics that unlock each student's genuine brilliance. Grounded in Dedication, Diligence, and Discipline, our faculty is dedicated to walking alongside every family in this journey.

managingDirector.name: Smita Sachin Singh
managingDirector.quote: “We do not prepare children only for the world they will enter, we empower them to create the world they wish to see.”
managingDirector.title: From The President's Desk
managingDirector.excerpt:
Dear Parents, Students, and Well-wishers,

It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Lotus Global School. Our school was founded with a simple but profound belief — that every child, regardless of where they are born, deserves access to education that prepares them not only for academic success but for life itself.

At LGS, we have created a positive and enriching environment where students develop intellectually, emotionally, and socially. We focus on building the confidence, discipline, and leadership qualities that help young people become responsible members of society. Every child who walks through our gates is unique, and we commit ourselves to discovering and nurturing that uniqueness.

Education, to me, remains the most powerful tool humanity has ever invented for shaping the future. Through the dedication of our teachers, the trust of our parents, and the effort of our students, we strive to inspire each learner to dream big, think deeply, and act with integrity.

As you explore our school — whether through these pages or by visiting our campus in Vapi— I hope you sense the warmth, purpose, and ambition that animate everything we do. We warmly welcome every student to be a part of the LGS family, and begin a journey toward a bright and meaningful future.

With best wishes and heartfelt regards,
managingDirector.fullMessage: We take great pride in creating an environment where curiosity is celebrated and disciplined growth is championed. Our facilities, faculty development programs, and child-safe campus standards ensure students in Vatar, Vapi have access to educational opportunities that match global standards.
